request.style: English, solo male baritone voice, warm and dignified, solo with choir, organ, acoustic guitar, strings, timpani, solemn, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Ner fathered Kish, Kish fathered Saul
Saul fathered Jonathan and Malchishua
Abinadab and Eshbaal came
The line of kings in Benjamin's name

[Verse]
Jonathan brought forth Merib-baal
Micah was born to Merib-baal
Pithon, Melech, Tarea, Ahaz
Ahaz fathered Jehoaddah's gaze

[Verse]
Jehoaddah had Alemeth there
Azmaveth and Zimri were fair
Zimri fathered Moza, it is said
Moza fathered Binea, so laid

[Verse]
Raphah was his son, Eleasah
Azel his son, the days that pass
Azel had six sons, names we know
Azrikam, Bocheru, in the flow

[Verse]
Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah
Hanan completed the family's tie
The sons of Eshek his brother stood
Ulam his firstborn, Jeush understood

[Verse]
Jeush the second, Eliphelet third
The sons of Ulam, mighty and firm
Archers who drew the bow with might
Many sons and grandsons, day and night

[Verse]
One hundred and fifty in all
Among the sons of Benjamin they dwell
The register keeps their names alive
In the tribal history, they thrive

[Outro]
All these were among the sons of Benjamin
